# Jeninnet.Validation

> A modular validation framework for .NET 10 / C# 14: fluent and attribute authoring, a Roslyn
> source generator, deterministic execution, a zero-allocation happy path, and first-class
> integrations for ASP.NET Core, Blazor, MediatR, GraphQL, gRPC, OpenAPI, JSON Schema, and
> desktop view models.

## Packages

- `Jeninnet.Validation` - core engine and fluent/attribute authoring.
- `Jeninnet.Validation.Abstractions` - public contracts.
- `Jeninnet.Validation.AspNetCore` - minimal API endpoint filter and MVC integration.
- `Jeninnet.Validation.Blazor` - `EditContext` adapter.
- `Jeninnet.Validation.DataAnnotations` - DataAnnotations bridge.
- `Jeninnet.Validation.JsonSchema` - JSON Schema generation.
- `Jeninnet.Validation.OpenApi` - OpenAPI constraints.
- `Jeninnet.Validation.MediatR` - MediatR pipeline behavior.
- `Jeninnet.Validation.GraphQL` - HotChocolate field middleware.
- `Jeninnet.Validation.Grpc` - gRPC interceptor.
- `Jeninnet.Validation.Observable` - `INotifyDataErrorInfo` adapter.
- `Jeninnet.Validation.Localization` - 40 message packs.
